title: Invariant 2: PostgreSQL/RuVector actively issues state, policy, tasks, leases, grants, branches, routes, gates, promotio...
goal: Prove operational invariant 2 holds against the live system. Shipped evidence only: a design document, a proposed ADR, or an intent to build never satisfies this probe.
command_template: PSQL="$(command -v psql || echo "$(dirname "$(readlink -f /proc/$(head -1 /home/flexnetos/meta/var/lib/postgresql/17/postmaster.pid 2>/dev/null)/exe 2>/dev/null)")/psql")"; test -x "$PSQL" && test "$("$PSQL" 'postgresql:///lifeos?host=/home/flexnetos/meta/var/run/postgresql' -tAc "select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema')")" -gt 0
verification_command: PSQL="$(command -v psql || echo "$(dirname "$(readlink -f /proc/$(head -1 /home/flexnetos/meta/var/lib/postgresql/17/postmaster.pid 2>/dev/null)/exe 2>/dev/null)")/psql")"; test -x "$PSQL" && "$PSQL" 'postgresql:///lifeos?host=/home/flexnetos/meta/var/run/postgresql' -tAc 'select pg_database_size(current_database())' | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'
completion_gate: probe exits 0 against the live system; a non-zero exit is a real invariant violation and must not be recorded as pending or proposed
rollback_plan: Read-only probe; nothing to roll back.
